output.summary: The denial cites the experimental services exclusion, so the policyholder must supply medical necessity and clinical evidence to challenge it. Note that the current gate indicates there is no formal appeal basis, so any new submission will be a supplemental request.

items.text: Obtain a physician’s written statement confirming the genetic test is medically necessary for diagnosis or treatment.
Provide clinical evidence (e.g., peer‑reviewed studies or professional guidelines) showing the specific test is recognized as standard care and not experimental.
Submit the physician’s statement and clinical evidence to the insurer referencing clause 8.2 to request reconsideration.
Because the denial was issued under gate EXCLUSION_NO_BASIS, there is currently no formal appeal basis; any new submission will be treated as a supplemental request.
